name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

parentCoordinator.description: Parent {@link MlWorkflowCoordinatable} that this result belongs to.

statusForCoordinatable.description:
Helper field for filtering during the coordinator implementation.
See {@link Workflow.Coordinatable} for status semantics.

canceledCount.description: Number of times the {@link #parentCoordinator} has canceled this result.

isCanceled.description:
True if the most recent execution of this result was canceled. This is used for quick filtering
to focus on canceled results.

errorCount.description:
Stores the count of errors that would be returned from {@link #errors}. This is used for quick filtering
to focus on results with errors.

run.description:
Reference to the {@link WorkflowExecutorRun} that executed the actions to execute this
result.

durationSeconds.description:
Duration in seconds of the most recent {@link #run} that executed the actions pertaining to this result.
This is used for quick filtering to focus on results with unexpected execution times (long or short).
This field is null if this result has not been executed.

pastRuns.description:
Reference to all past {@link WorkflowExecutorRun}s that executed the actions pertaining to this
result.

attemptedRecoveryCount.description: Number of times the {@link #parentCoordinator} has attempted to recover this result.

project.description: Specify the {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} for which the post model training job should be run.

asset.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset} for which model validation/classification/reporting should be run.

model.description: The {@link ReliabilityMlModel} for which the post training job is run.

referenceTimeRange.description:
The reference period for which a {@link ReliabilityMl.ModelOutput}s are generated in order to determine how the
model performs. This usually can correspond to the training period for the model, since the model is expected to
perform well on the training data

Use `ReliabilityMl.TimeRange.TRAIN` to use the training time range associated with a {@link ReliabilityMlModel#datasetPreparationRun},
or instead provide your own custom time range.

The model outputs from this period can be compared with the model outputs generated for the {@link #comparisonTimeRange} to
classify the model.

comparisonTimeRange.description:
The comparison period for which a {@link ReliabilityMl.ModelOutput}s are generated in order to determine how the
model performs. This can correspond to the validation period for the model, since the model is expected to
perform well as well on held out validation data as the training data.

Use `ReliabilityMl.TimeRange.VAL` to use the validation time range associated with a {@link ReliabilityMlModel#datasetPreparationRun},
or instead provide your own custom time range.

The model outputs from this period can be compared with the model outputs generated for the {@link #referenceTimeRange} to
classify the model.

doNotClassify.description:
Specify whether to classify the {@link #model} after it is trained. By default this
field is set to False, meaning the model will be classified.
The classification logic must be specified in the {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#classifyModelForAssetLambda} associated with the
{@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.PostTrainingJob}

doNotValidate.description:
Specify whether to validate the {@link #model} after it is trained. By default this
field is set to False, meaning the model will be validated.

doNotGenerateValidationReports.description:
Specify whether to generate model validation reports for the {@link #model} after it is trained.
By default this field is set to False, meaning that a model report will be generated.
The reporting logic must be specified in the {@link ReliabilityMl.Project#reportModelForAssetLambda} associated with the
{@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.PostTrainingJob}

title:
Represents the post training workflow that will be executed to validate/classify/generate reports for a single
{@link ReliabilityMlModel} - {@link ReliabilityAsset} and for a specific {@link MlProject}.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.PostTrainingJobResult
